text:
kenji: Quick async standup — API gateway / routing / auth / rate-limits

What I did: landed a tiny routing fallback for model-variant routing and trimmed a couple kernel args to reduce cold start.
Blockers: intermittent 429s from thin-client in us-west, unclear if quota, auth churn, or a routing hot-path.
Today: add short-lived token retry with exponential backoff + a revertable canary for a small ratepolicy tweak. Will open PRs shortly.

maria: Nice, please drop the PR link here when ready. I can review by noon. FYI I pushed a micro-change to the rate-policy precedence — can you sanity-check? snippet:
```yaml
rate_limit:
  - match: { path_prefix: "/v1/engines" }
    limit: 500/s
```
Seems high for global, we should prefer per-customer override.

zach: I saw the 429 spike around 10:23-10:30 on grafana. Traced to client_id=integrations-legacy — they were rotating tokens every ~30s which turned retries into a retry storm. I can open a targeted client-throttle policy to quiet it.

olivia: Pasting a trace: https://console.redwood.ai/trace/abcd1234 — shows a retry loop hitting routing table misses. Also: consider bumping KV cache TTL for the routing table to reduce cold lookups.

tess: Oncall note — I can pick up handover at 17:00 if this is still noisy. @kenji if you change canary thresholds please post a short note in #incidents so ops knows. :memo: 

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started by kenji for gateway-ratepolicy v2 -> 10% traffic. monitor: https://deploys.redwood.ai/12345 :rocket:

kenji: Thanks — plan is two small PRs: (1) auth retry/backoff (2) client-throttle for integrations-legacy. Tagging @maria for review. If 10% looks clean in 20m I'll bump to 50%. If anything unexpectedly regresses we'll roll back. No other blockers at this time.

maria: LGTM on the client-throttle approach, leave a test script in the PR for QA to simulate token churn. :+1:

zach: I'll continue tailing logs and post any regressions. If 429s persist after throttle, we should consider a circuit-breaker at the proxy layer or limiting concurrent KV lookups.
